capital.evidence_quote: Singapore is an island city-state and sovereign republic

currency.evidence_quote: The Singapore Dollar (SGD) is the official currency of Singapore

timezone.evidence_quote: Singapore Standard Time maintains a constant offset of UTC+8 without daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential electricity in Singapore is delivered at 230V single phase

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The Singapore national electrical grid frequency is standardized at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Singapore electrical wall sockets adhere to British Type G 3-pin rectangular plug standards

police.evidence_quote: Emergency police dispatch hotline in Singapore is 999

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency medical ambulance and fire dispatch is operated through 995

fire.evidence_quote: SCDF firefighting emergency services respond to 995

general.evidence_quote: Main emergency line 999 coordinates urgent inter-agency responses

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Singapore Tourism Board operates toll-free tourist hotline 1800 736 2000

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Singapore mobile speeds average 112.5 Mbps with extensive nationwide standalone 5G

esim_sim_notes.value: eSIM is readily available. Singtel, StarHub, and M1 offer tourist eSIMs and physical SIMs at Changi Airport with mandatory passport registration under IMDA regulations.

religion.evidence_quote: Singapore is a harmonious multi-religious society officially recognizing diverse cultural traditions

festivals.value: Çin Yeni Yılı, Hari Raya Puasa, Deepavali, Singapur Ulusal Günü (9 Ağustos), Vesak Günü
festivals.evidence_quote: National Day on August 9 and multicultural public holidays are celebrated nationwide

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Sakız ithalatı ve satışı yasaktır. Yere çöp atma, metroda yeme-içme ve sigara yasakları binlerce SGD para cezasına tabidir. Uyuşturucu kaçakçılığı için ölüm cezası uygulanır. Prizler İngiliz Tipi G'dir.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Chewing gum is prohibited from import; strict fines apply to public cleanliness infractions

tipping.value: Restoranlarda %10 servis ücreti ve GST hesaba otomatik eklenir, ekstra bahşiş beklenmez. Hawker merkezlerinde bahşiş bırakılmaz.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is not customary as restaurants add a 10 percent service charge to bills
